sentences.text: Today, we will talk about Finland.
Finland is a quiet and beautiful country in Europe.
Let's learn about it in simple English.
I will speak slowly.
You can listen and repeat if you want.
Where is Finland?
Finland is in Northern Europe.
It is part of Scandinavia or the Nordic region.
It is next to Sweden, Norway and Russia.
To the south, it is close to Estonia, across the sea.
Finland has many forests, lakes and quiet towns.
What is the capital city of Finland?
The capital city is Helsinki.
It is on the southern coast near the sea.
Helsinki is modern and clean.
It has shops, museums, parks and boats.
Other cities in Finland include Turku, Tampere and Oulu.
How many people live in Finland?
About five.
Five million people live in Finland.
Most people live in the south of the country.
There are many small towns and villages.
Finland is not crowded.
There is a lot of space and nature.
What language do people speak in Finland?
People speak Finnish.
Finnish is the official language.
Some people also speak Swedish.
It is the second official language.
Most people also speak English, especially young people.
English is taught in schools.
In big cities, you can use English easily.
What is the weather like in Finland?
Finland has four seasons.
Winter, spring, summer and autumn.
Winter is long and cold.
It snows a lot.
The days are short and dark.
In the north, the sun does not rise for many days.
This is called the polar night.
Summer is short but beautiful.
The days are long and sunny.
In some places, the sun does not set.
This is called the midnight sun.
Spring and autumn are cool with rain and wind.
What does Finland look like?
Finland is full of forests and lakes.
There are over 180,000 lakes in Finland.
The land is flat and green.
There are many quiet and peaceful places.
In the north, there is a region called Lapland.
It is cold and snowy.
It is the home of reindeer and some say Santa Claus.
What animals live in Finland?
Finland has many wild animals.
You can see moose, reindeer, foxes and hares.
In the forests, there are bears and wolves, but they are shy.
There are also many birds and fish in the lakes.
People enjoy fishing and bird watching.
What do people eat in Finland?
Finnish food is simple and natural.
People eat a lot of fish, potatoes, bread and berries.
One traditional food is rye bread.
It is dark and strong in taste.
Another dish is salmon soup made with fish, potatoes and cream.
People also eat reindeer meat, especially in Lapland.
In summer, people pick blueberries, lingonberries and mushrooms.
They also eat porridge, cheese and cinnamon buns.
Coffee is very popular in Finland.
People drink a lot of coffee, more than in most other countries.
What is life like in Finland?
Life in Finland is quiet and calm.
People like nature, peace and privacy.
They enjoy walking, skiing and spending time in the forest.
Education is very important in Finland.
Schools are free and very good.
Children play and learn in a relaxed way.
People also love the sauna.
A sauna is a small, hot room.
People go there to relax and sweat.
There are saunas in homes, schools and even offices.
Some fun facts about Finland.
Finland became independent in 1917.
The flag is white with a blue cross.
Finland uses the Euro.
In the north, you can see the northern lights in winter.
Finland is often called the happiest country in the world.
Every year, Finland has a wife -carrying championship.
It's a fun race.
Now you know many things about Finland.
You know where it is, what language people speak and what the weather is like.
You know about the lakes, animals, food and daily life.
Great job!
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I'm Emili.
